"Untitled Goose Game: Honk, Prank, Repeat!"

Pros:

Embrace your inner goose and create chaos in a charming village.
Sneak, honk, and steal your way to victory with hilarious tasks.
Stylish accessories turn you into the most fashionable fowl in town.

Cons:

Ducks might feel left out, but this game's all about goose power!
No support group for post-honking therapy sessions.

Verdict: Honk if you love uncontrollable laughter! This game is an untitled masterpiece of avian antics.
If you want a lighthearted game that involves annoying the people you interact with, you can't do any better than Untitled Goose Game.

Untitled Goose Game is a pandemic classic. The game was initially teased for the Nintendo Switch, but I held out for the PC release. Design wise, the graphics are charming and cute, with faceless characters that are expressive and visually interesting. I think that the designers nailed the rural, idyllic small town feel of the game. The sound effects are well designed and the music is similarly cute and charming to complement the graphics. Performance was great and likely will be for all but those playing on a Raspberry Pi.

The puzzles are not overly challenging yet difficult enough to keep you engaged in the game. I played Untitled Goose Game over three 1 hour sessions with my younger sibling and we had a total blast figuring out the puzzles to complete the tasks. Each "scene" in the game is different enough to be interesting on its own. The movement of the goose is simple to manage and allows for perfect heists and acts of slight-of-hand. The game feels like you are playing through an episode of British children's television, and that is not a complaint. Certainly a fun game for anyone, I would recommend playing with a buddy via couch co-op.

I'm a bit late to the Untitled Goose Game train. I've wanted to play it since I first heard of it but just never got around to it. Now that I finally did, I'm so glad I did. Untitled Goose Game is a cute puzzle game where the puzzles are not too hard that you can't complete them, but not so easy you can breeze through the whole game. The design of the game as a whole is so charming and enjoyable, and the stories you see play out as you as the goose mess with the people around you are enjoyable as well. My only complaint is I wish there was more to this game, I love all the levels but I want more, I crave more Honk.
If you're behind like me and haven't picked this one up already, I highly suggest it.
